workflow.description: Workflow AI Fashion giúp tạo video thời trang cao cấp trong bối cảnh thang máy hiện đại với phong cách editorial sang trọng. Hệ thống giữ nguyên khuôn mặt nhân vật, tạo chuyển động điện ảnh, ánh sáng chuyên nghiệp và bố cục thời trang như một chiến dịch quảng cáo thực tế.

nodes.prompt:
REFERENCE LOCK

image_1 = Identity reference ONLY.
Lock the identity throughout the entire video.

Maintain identical:
• eye shape
• eye size
• eye spacing
• eyelids
• eyebrows
• eyelashes
• nose
• lips
• jawline
• cheekbones
• forehead
• hairline
• skin texture
• facial proportions
• facial expression

The facial identity must remain unchanged in every frame.
Never regenerate, reinterpret or beautify the face.


image_2:
Use ONLY as the outfit and styling reference.

Preserve exactly every visible fashion item from image_2, including:
• all garments
• handbag
• belt
• scarf
• jewelry
• footwear
• any outfit-related accessories

Maintain exactly:
• design
• silhouette
• proportions
• materials
• textures
• colors
• patterns
• stitching
• hardware
• layering
• styling

Do not redesign, replace, remove or reinterpret any visible fashion item.

Do not inherit any facial features, hairstyle, skin tone or body shape from image_2.

If another reference image explicitly defines a specific accessory (for example sunglasses), that reference overrides image_2 only for that accessory.


image_3:
Use ONLY as the elevator architecture reference.

Recreate the elevator from image_3 exactly.

Lock:
• elevator cabin
• door
• door frame
• wall panels
• ceiling
• lighting fixtures
• button panel
• floor
• brushed stainless-steel material
• reflections
• perspective
• symmetry
• architectural layout

Only inherit the elevator architecture.

Do NOT inherit from image_3:
• color grading
• white balance
• exposure
• contrast
• saturation
• skin tone
• facial lighting
• wardrobe colors
• handbag colors
• global color palette

Only the elevator architecture may be inherited from image_3.


Priority

1. Identity (image_1)
2. Outfit (image_2)
3. Elevator Architecture (image_3)
4. Motion


VIDEO LENGTH

6 seconds
24 fps
9:16


STYLE

Ultra-realistic luxury fashion commercial.
Premium editorial campaign.
Cinematic realism.
Not AI-looking.


SCENE

Use the elevator architecture from image_3 exactly.

Keep identical:
• elevator geometry
• materials
• wall layout
• ceiling
• floor
• reflections
• perspective

The model must NOT inherit the lighting or color grading from image_3.

No people except the model.


CAMERA

Locked camera on tripod.

Eye-level, slightly lower than the model's face.

50mm lens.

Deep depth of field.

No zoom.
No dolly.
No handheld movement.
No camera shake.
No focus breathing.

Maintain identical framing during the entire shot.


TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY

Maintain perfect frame-to-frame consistency.

The same person must appear in every frame.

The face in the final frame must be identical to the first frame.

No identity drift.

No identity regeneration.

No facial morphing.

No frame-to-frame facial variation.

The elevator must remain identical in every frame.

No architectural changes.

No reflection drift.

No environment regeneration.


LIGHTING

Soft overhead key light with subtle frontal fill.

5600K neutral daylight.

Luxury commercial beauty lighting.

Medium contrast.

Clean stainless-steel reflections.

Maintain warm healthy skin tones regardless of the cool elevator environment.


SKIN TONE LOCK

Maintain natural healthy skin tones.

Preserve realistic warm skin color.

Natural pink undertones.

Healthy skin saturation.

Do not desaturate the skin.

Do not introduce blue, gray or green color cast.

Do not inherit the cool metallic color cast from the elevator.

Skin must remain vibrant and naturally illuminated throughout the video.


COLOR SEPARATION

The elevator may retain cool metallic gray tones.

The model must retain warm healthy skin tones.

Keep the model visually separated from the cool environment.

The environment must never change the perceived skin color.


FACIAL LIGHTING LOCK

Facial lighting must remain constant throughout the video.

No exposure fluctuation on the face.

No changing skin tone.

No changing facial shadows.

No lighting flicker across frames.


TIMELINE

0.00–0.60s

The elevator doors remain fully closed.

Everything is perfectly still.

A short cinematic pause builds anticipation.


0.60–1.20s

The elevator doors open quickly and smoothly with premium commercial precision.

The camera never moves.

As the doors open, the model is gradually revealed standing perfectly centered.


1.20–1.40s

The doors finish opening completely.

The model immediately establishes eye contact with the camera.

She stands naturally with confident posture.


1.40–6.00s

The model performs one elegant editorial pose:

• slightly shift body weight onto one leg
• rotate shoulders around 10°
• gently lift the handbag

Only a subtle chin lift.

Very subtle breathing.

Very subtle natural hair movement.

Hair never covers the face.

Hairline remains unchanged.

One natural blink only.

Eyes return to exactly the same shape after blinking.

No head rotation.

No face rotation.

No perspective change.

Maintain stable head orientation.

Relaxed confident expression.

Hold the final pose for the last 0.6 seconds.


MODEL PERFORMANCE

Luxury fashion campaign energy.

Confident but effortless.

No smile.

Natural facial muscles.

No exaggerated runway movements.

Every movement should feel realistic and minimal.

Maintain stable head orientation.

Maintain consistent eye contact.


OUTFIT

Use image_2 exactly.

Do not alter any seam, silhouette, fabric, proportions, handbag, accessories or colors.


ENVIRONMENT

Use image_3 ONLY for the elevator architecture.

Keep the elevator perfectly symmetrical.

Keep reflections physically accurate.

No geometry changes.

No material changes.

No background changes.

No lighting flicker.


IMAGE QUALITY

Ultra realistic.

High dynamic range.

Natural skin texture.

Healthy vibrant skin.

Premium stainless-steel reflections.

Luxury commercial finish.

No AI artifacts.


NEGATIVE PROMPT

camera shake, handheld, zoom, dolly, focus hunting, rolling shutter, frame jitter, flickering lights, warped elevator, different elevator, architectural drift, reflection drift, environment regeneration, cool skin tone, blue skin, gray skin, green skin, desaturated skin, changing white balance, changing color grading, changing outfit, handbag deformation, handbag size change, identity drift, identity regeneration, face regeneration, facial morphing, frame-to-frame face variation, eye shape changes, eyelid changes, eyebrow changes, nose changes, jawline changes, cheekbone changes, hairline changes, skin texture changes, facial proportion changes, inconsistent facial lighting, extra people, exaggerated posing, smiling, unrealistic body motion, motion blur, low resolution, oversharpening, noisy image, AI artifacts.

nodes.prompt:
REFERENCE LOCK

image_1 = Face Identity Reference ONLY.

The person in image_1 IS the final character.

Use image_1 exclusively as the facial identity source.

Treat image_1 as immutable identity data.

Extract and preserve ONLY the facial identity.

Never recreate, redesign, beautify, reinterpret, approximate or synthesize the face.

The facial identity must remain pixel-faithful throughout the entire video.

Lock permanently:

• face shape

• facial proportions

• facial asymmetry

• forehead

• hairline

• eyebrows

• eyebrow shape

• eye shape

• eye size

• eye spacing

• eyelids

• eyelashes

• iris color

• nose

• nostrils

• lips

• lip thickness

• mouth width

• jawline

• cheekbones

• ears

• skin tone

• skin texture

• pores

• fine facial details

• neutral facial expression

Never inherit clothing, hairstyle, accessories, body pose, lighting or environment from image_1.

image_2 = Master Open-Door Scene Reference.

Treat image_2 as the final approved scene after the elevator doors have completely opened.

Image_2 is NOT the first frame of the video.

Image_2 defines the target fully opened-door state.

Treat image_2 as immutable visual source data.

Never use image_2 as inspiration.

Never redesign any part of image_2.

Everything visible in image_2 except the face is authoritative.

Replace ONLY the facial identity using image_1.

Preserve exactly:

SCENE

• elevator architecture

• elevator dimensions

• wall spacing

• wall proportions

• door proportions

• door frame

• ceiling

• floor

• wall panels

• joints

• seams

• button panel

• control panel

• reflections

• materials

• textures

• colors

• scratches

• surface imperfections

• every visible architectural detail

CAMERA

• camera position

• camera height

• camera distance

• camera angle

• perspective

• framing

• composition

• subject scale

• headroom

• left margin

• right margin

• negative space

• vanishing point

• horizon

MODEL

• body placement

• standing position

• body orientation

• shoulder position

• arm position

• hand position

• leg position

• body proportions

• body scale

HAIR

• hairstyle

• hair length

• hair direction

• hair volume

• hair placement

ACCESSORIES

• eyeglasses

• eyeglass frame

• eyeglass color

• handbag

• handbag position

• handbag angle

• handbag strap position

• jewelry

• earrings

• necklace

• bracelet

• watch

• every visible accessory

OUTFIT

• garment design

• garment colors

• garment materials

• garment texture

• garment silhouette

• garment proportions

• garment fit

• clothing folds

• fabric drape

• sleeve position

• skirt position

• every visible outfit detail

LIGHTING

• lighting layout

• light direction

• exposure

• reflections

• shadow placement

Everything outside the face must remain visually identical to image_2.

Completely ignore ONLY the facial identity from image_2.

REFERENCE FUSION

The references are complementary.

Never blend identities.

Never average identities.

The final result must use:

• Facial Identity → image_1

• Everything Else → image_2

Image_2 is the master visual reference.

Image_1 replaces only the facial identity.

Everything else remains unchanged.

SCENE REFERENCE INTERPRETATION

Image_2 is NOT:

• a style reference

• an inspiration reference

• an approximate reference

Image_2 IS:

• the master scene

• the master camera

• the master composition

• the master environment

• the master outfit reference

• the master accessory reference

• the master body placement reference

Treat every visible non-facial element in image_2 as immutable.

Never recreate the scene.

Never redesign the scene.

Never reinterpret the scene.

Animate the existing scene only.

REFERENCE CONFLICT RULE

If any written instruction conflicts with image_2,

always follow image_2.

Image_2 overrides every:

• scene description

• environment description

• camera description

• composition description

• outfit description

• accessory description

• body placement description

• lighting description

Never redesign the scene to satisfy the written prompt.

Image_2 is the final authority for every non-facial element.

PRIORITY

1. Face Identity (image_1)

2. Everything Else (image_2)

3. Motion

4. Rendering Quality

IDENTITY RULE

Identity preservation overrides every other rendering objective.

The face must never be regenerated.

Never redraw the face.

Never synthesize missing facial features.

Never modify facial anatomy.

Never modify facial proportions.

Never modify facial perspective.

Every rendered frame must appear as if the original face from image_1 is simply being animated while every non-facial element remains identical to image_2.


VIDEO

Duration: 6 seconds.

Frame rate: 24 fps.

Aspect ratio: 9:16.

STYLE

Ultra-realistic luxury fashion commercial.

Premium editorial campaign.

Cinematic realism.

Natural skin.

Natural fabric.

Physically accurate lighting.

Photorealistic stainless-steel reflections.

Not AI-looking.

SCENE

The entire environment is defined by image_2.

Image_2 represents the fully opened-door state.

The elevator shown in image_2 already exists before the animation begins.

The opening doors only reveal the existing elevator.

The elevator must never be regenerated.

The elevator must never be replaced.

The elevator must never be redesigned.

The elevator must remain visually identical to image_2 throughout the entire video.

Preserve exactly:

• elevator architecture

• wall proportions

• ceiling

• floor

• wall panels

• door frame

• door proportions

• joints

• seams

• control panel

• buttons

• materials

• colors

• textures

• scratches

• surface imperfections

• reflections

• every visible architectural detail

No visual redesign is allowed.

No material changes.

No texture changes.

No color changes.

No reflection changes.

ELEVATOR CONTINUITY

The elevator exists from the very first frame.

Before the doors open, the elevator interior already exists behind the closed doors.

The closed doors simply conceal the existing elevator.

Door opening is only a reveal animation.

Door opening must never generate a new elevator.

Door opening must never regenerate the scene.

Door opening must reveal exactly the same elevator shown in image_2.

The elevator interior must remain identical before, during and after the doors open.

CAMERA

Treat image_2 as the master camera reference.

Maintain permanently:

• camera position

• camera height

• camera distance

• camera angle

• framing

• perspective

• composition

• subject scale

• headroom

• left margin

• right margin

• negative space

• vanishing point

• horizon

• elevator alignment

Locked camera.

No camera movement.

No zoom.

No dolly.

No orbit.

No crane.

No handheld movement.

No camera shake.

No focus breathing.

No focal length change.

No perspective shift.

Every frame must preserve the identical framing established by image_2.

LAYOUT LOCK

Maintain exactly:

• subject X position

• subject Y position

• subject scale

• distance to elevator doors

• distance to frame edges

• visual balance

• empty space

The composition must remain unchanged.

Only the model is allowed to move.

The camera never follows the model.

LIGHTING

Image_2 defines the environmental lighting.

Maintain:

• lighting direction

• exposure

• reflection placement

• reflection intensity

• reflection colors

• shadow placement

Facial lighting remains constant.

No lighting flicker.

No exposure fluctuation.

No color temperature shift.

Maintain the identical commercial lighting established by image_2.

BACKGROUND CONTINUITY

The elevator is a completely static environment.

The background never updates.

The background never changes.

The elevator walls remain fixed.

The ceiling remains fixed.

The floor remains fixed.

The reflections remain fixed.

The architectural details remain fixed.

Only the elevator doors and the model are allowed to animate.

The camera never follows the subject.

The environment never reacts to the model's movement.


HEAD LOCK

The head remains almost perfectly stationary throughout the video.

Maximum head rotation:

• Yaw ±2°

• Pitch ±2°

• Roll ±2°

Maximum head translation: ±1 cm.

The nose continuously faces the camera.

Maintain identical facial perspective throughout the video.

Hair moves naturally but never covers the face.

Eyeglasses remain perfectly aligned as shown in image_2.

BODY MOTION

Only the body performs the pose.

Keep all movement elegant, minimal and realistic.

Allowed motion:

• natural weight shift onto one leg

• upper torso rotation up to approximately 5°

• handbag lift up to approximately 5 cm

• subtle shoulder movement

• subtle breathing

The head remains nearly fixed.

No exaggerated motion.

No facial deformation.

No blink.

No expression change.

TIMELINE

0.00–0.60 s

The elevator doors are fully closed.

Everything is perfectly still.

The camera remains completely locked.

The elevator behind the doors already exists exactly as defined by image_2.

0.60–1.20 s

The elevator doors open smoothly.

Only the doors move.

The elevator itself never changes.

The camera remains completely locked.

Opening the doors reveals the existing elevator shown in image_2.

No new environment may be generated.

1.20–1.40 s

The elevator doors finish opening.

The scene now matches the fully opened-door reference defined by image_2.

The model is already looking directly into the camera.

Pause briefly before movement begins.

MASTER FRAME MATCH

The first fully opened-door frame becomes the Master Frame.

This frame must be visually identical to image_2 except:

• facial identity replaced using image_1.

Everything else remains identical to image_2.

From this moment onward, every frame must preserve the same scene.

FRAME STABILITY

After the Master Frame has been established, maintain permanently:

• identical elevator

• identical architecture

• identical materials

• identical textures

• identical colors

• identical reflections

• identical lighting

• identical camera position

• identical framing

• identical perspective

• identical subject placement

The environment never changes.

The elevator never changes.

The background never changes.

Only the model performs subtle motion.

Only the elevator doors may animate during the opening sequence.

1.40–6.00 s

The model performs one elegant editorial pose.

Shift body weight naturally.

Rotate only the upper torso slightly.

Lift the handbag slightly.

Maintain uninterrupted eye contact.

Keep the head almost perfectly fixed.

Finish by holding the final pose steadily during the last 0.6 seconds.

MODEL PERFORMANCE

Luxury editorial fashion campaign.

Elegant.

Confident.

Natural.

Minimal movement.

Neutral facial muscles.

No smile.

Constant eye contact.

No expression drift.

OUTFIT & ACCESSORIES

Everything outside the face must remain identical to image_2.

Preserve exactly:

• eyeglasses

• handbag

• handbag position

• handbag angle

• handbag strap

• jewelry

• watch

• bracelet

• shoes

• garment fit

• garment folds

• fabric drape

• every visible accessory

Do not reposition any accessory.

Do not redesign any accessory.

Do not alter the way the outfit is worn.

IMAGE QUALITY

Ultra-realistic.

High dynamic range.

Natural skin texture.

Natural fabric texture.

Physically accurate reflections.

Commercial fashion photography quality.

No AI artifacts.

FINAL IDENTITY CHECK

Before rendering every frame:

Verify that the facial identity remains identical to image_1.

If any facial feature differs from image_1,

discard the frame and regenerate it.

Identity preservation overrides every other rendering objective.

FINAL SCENE CHECK

Before rendering every frame:

Verify that the environment remains identical to image_2.

The elevator must never change.

The camera must never move.

The background must never regenerate.

The scene must never drift.

Only the model and the elevator doors may animate.

face replacement,

face regeneration,

face redraw,

face morphing,

identity blending,

identity averaging,

beauty enhancement,

plastic skin,

CGI face,
